verses.original: וַיְכֻלּ֛וּ הַשָּׁמַ֥יִם וְהָאָ֖רֶץ וְכָל־ צְבָאָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḵul·lū haš·šā·ma·yim wə·hā·’ā·reṣ wə·ḵāl ṣə·ḇā·’ām
verses.literal: Thus the heavens and the earth were completed in all their vast array
verses.literalPt: Assim foram acabados o céu e a terra, com todo o seu exército.

verses.original: וַיְכַ֤ל אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י מְלַאכְתּ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה וַיִּשְׁבֹּת֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י מִכָּל־ מְלַאכְתּ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḵal ’ĕ·lō·hîm bay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î mə·laḵ·tōw ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh way·yiš·bōṯ bay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î mik·kāl mə·laḵ·tōw ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: And by the seventh day God had finished the work He had been doing so on that day He rested from all His work . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: No sétimo dia, acabou Deus a obra que tinha feito; e cessou, no sétimo dia, de toda a obra que fizera.

verses.original: וַיְבָ֤רֶךְ אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־ י֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י וַיְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֹת֑וֹ כִּ֣י ב֤וֹ שָׁבַת֙ מִכָּל־ מְלַאכְתּ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּרָ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ḇā·reḵ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î way·qad·dêš ’ō·ṯōw kî ḇōw šā·ḇaṯ mik·kāl mə·laḵ·tōw ’ă·šer- bā·rā ’ĕ·lō·hîm la·‘ă·śō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it because on that day He rested from all the work of creation that He had accomplished
verses.literalPt: Abençoou Deus o dia sétimo e o santificou; porque nele cessou de toda a obra que fizera como Criador.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה תוֹלְד֧וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם וְהָאָ֖רֶץ בְּהִבָּֽרְאָ֑ם בְּי֗וֹם עֲשׂ֛וֹת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶ֥רֶץ וְשָׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ṯō·wl·ḏō·wṯ haš·šā·ma·yim wə·hā·’ā·reṣ bə·hib·bā·rə·’ām bə·yō·wm ‘ă·śō·wṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’e·reṣ wə·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: This is the account of the heavens and the earth when they were created in the day that the LORD God made them . . .
verses.literalPt: Estas são as gerações do céu e da terra quando foram criados, no dia em que Deus Jeová os criou.

verses.original: וְכֹ֣ל׀ שִׂ֣יחַ הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה טֶ֚רֶם יִֽהְיֶ֣ה בָאָ֔רֶץ וְכָל־ עֵ֥שֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה טֶ֣רֶם יִצְמָ֑ח כִּי֩ לֹ֨א הִמְטִ֜יר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאָדָ֣ם אַ֔יִן לַֽעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־ הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl śî·aḥ haś·śā·ḏeh ṭe·rem yih·yeh ḇā·’ā·reṣ wə·ḵāl ‘ê·śeḇ haś·śā·ḏeh ṭe·rem yiṣ·māḥ kî lō him·ṭîr Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·’ā·ḏām ’a·yin la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: Now no shrub of the field had yet appeared on the earth nor had any plant of the field sprouted for the LORD God had not yet sent rain upon the earth and there was no man to cultivate the ground
verses.literalPt: Não havia ainda nenhuma planta na terra, e nenhuma erva no campo tinha ainda brotado; porque Deus Jeová não tinha feito chover sobre a terra. Não havia homem que cultivasse o solo,

verses.original: וְאֵ֖ד יַֽעֲלֶ֣ה מִן־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהִשְׁקָ֖ה אֶֽת־ כָּל־ פְּנֵֽי־ הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êḏ ya·‘ă·leh min- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hiš·qāh ’eṯ- kāl- pə·nê- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: But springs welled up from the earth and watered the whole surface of the ground
verses.literalPt: mas uma neblina subia da terra e regava toda a superfície do solo.

verses.original: וַיִּיצֶר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶת־ הָֽאָדָ֗ם עָפָר֙ מִן־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה וַיִּפַּ֥ח בְּאַפָּ֖יו נִשְׁמַ֣ת חַיִּ֑ים וַֽיְהִ֥י הָֽאָדָ֖ם לְנֶ֥פֶשׁ חַיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yî·ṣer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- hā·’ā·ḏām ‘ā·p̄ār min- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh way·yip·paḥ bə·’ap·pāw niš·maṯ ḥay·yîm way·hî hā·’ā·ḏām lə·ne·p̄eš ḥay·yāh
verses.literal: Then the LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground and breathed the breath of life into his nostrils and the man became a living being
verses.literalPt: Do pó da terra formou Deus Jeová ao homem e soprou-lhe nas narinas o fôlego de vida; e o homem tornou-se um ser vivente.

verses.original: וַיִּטַּ֞ע יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהִ֛ים גַּן־ בְעֵ֖דֶן מִקֶּ֑דֶם וַיָּ֣שֶׂם שָׁ֔ם אֶת־ הָֽאָדָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָצָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṭ·ṭa‘ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm gan- bə·‘ê·ḏen miq·qe·ḏem way·yā·śem šām ’eṯ- hā·’ā·ḏām ’ă·šer yā·ṣār
verses.literal: And the LORD God planted a garden in Eden in the east where He placed the man He had formed
verses.literalPt: Então, plantou Deus Jeová um jardim, da banda do Oriente, no Éden; e ali pôs o homem que tinha formado.

verses.original: וַיַּצְמַ֞ח יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ מִן־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה כָּל־ עֵ֛ץ נֶחְמָ֥ד לְמַרְאֶ֖ה וְט֣וֹב לְמַאֲכָ֑ל וְעֵ֤ץ הַֽחַיִּים֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַגָּ֔ן וְעֵ֕ץ הַדַּ֖עַת ט֥וֹב וָרָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaṣ·maḥ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm min- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh kāl- ‘êṣ neḥ·māḏ lə·mar·’eh wə·ṭō·wḇ lə·ma·’ă·ḵāl wə·‘êṣ ha·ḥay·yîm bə·ṯō·wḵ hag·gān wə·‘êṣ had·da·‘aṯ ṭō·wḇ wā·rā‘
verses.literal: Out of the ground the LORD God gave growth to every tree that is pleasing to the eye and good for food And in the middle of the garden were the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil
verses.literalPt: Fez Deus Jeová brotar do solo toda a sorte de árvores gratas à vista e boas para comida; também a árvore da vida, no meio do jardim, e a árvore do conhecimento do bem e do mal.

verses.original: וְנָהָר֙ יֹצֵ֣א מֵעֵ֔דֶן לְהַשְׁק֖וֹת אֶת־ הַגָּ֑ן וּמִשָּׁם֙ יִפָּרֵ֔ד וְהָיָ֖ה לְאַרְבָּעָ֥ה רָאשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nå̄·hå̄r yō·ṣê mê·‘ê·ḏen lə·haš·qō·wṯ ’eṯ- hag·gān ū·miš·šām yip·pā·rêḏ wə·hā·yāh lə·’ar·bā·‘āh rā·šîm
verses.literal: Now a river flowed out of Eden to water the garden and from there it branched into . . . four headwaters
verses.literalPt: Do Éden saía um rio para regar o jardim; dali se dividia e se tornava em quatro braços.

verses.original: שֵׁ֥ם הָֽאֶחָ֖ד פִּישׁ֑וֹן ה֣וּא הַסֹּבֵ֗ב אֵ֚ת כָּל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽחֲוִילָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֖ם הַזָּהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: šêm hā·’e·ḥāḏ pî·šō·wn hū has·sō·ḇêḇ ’êṯ kāl- ’e·reṣ ha·ḥă·wî·lāh ’ă·šer- šām haz·zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: The name of the first river is the Pishon it winds through the whole land of Havilah where there is gold
verses.literalPt: O nome do primeiro é Pisom: este é o que rodeia toda a terra de Havilá, onde há ouro.

verses.original: וּֽזֲהַ֛ב הָאָ֥רֶץ הַהִ֖וא ט֑וֹב שָׁ֥ם הַבְּדֹ֖לַח וְאֶ֥בֶן הַשֹּֽׁהַם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ză·haḇ hā·’ā·reṣ ha·hi·w ṭō·wḇ šām hab·bə·ḏō·laḥ wə·’e·ḇen haš·šō·ham
verses.literal: And the gold of that land is pure and bdellium and onyx are found there
verses.literalPt: O ouro daquela terra é bom; ali também se acha o bdélio e a pedra de ônix.

verses.original: וְשֵֽׁם־ הַנָּהָ֥ר הַשֵּׁנִ֖י גִּיח֑וֹן ה֣וּא הַסּוֹבֵ֔ב אֵ֖ת כָּל־ אֶ֥רֶץ כּֽוּשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šêm- han·nā·hār haš·šê·nî gî·ḥō·wn hū has·sō·w·ḇêḇ ’êṯ kāl- ’e·reṣ kūš
verses.literal: The name of the second river is the Gihon it winds through the whole land of Cush
verses.literalPt: O nome do segundo rio é Giom: este é o que rodeia toda a terra de Cuxe.

verses.original: וְשֵׁ֨ם הַנָּהָ֤ר הַשְּׁלִישִׁי֙ חִדֶּ֔קֶל ה֥וּא הַֽהֹלֵ֖ךְ קִדְמַ֣ת אַשּׁ֑וּר וְהַנָּהָ֥ר הָֽרְבִיעִ֖י ה֥וּא פְרָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šêm han·nā·hār haš·šə·lî·šî ḥid·de·qel hū ha·hō·lêḵ qiḏ·maṯ ’aš·šūr wə·han·nā·hār hā·rə·ḇî·‘î hū p̄ə·rāṯ
verses.literal: The name of the third river is the Tigris it runs along the east side of Assyria And the fourth river is the Euphrates
verses.literalPt: O nome do terceiro rio é Tigre: este é o que corre pelo oriente da Assíria. E o quarto é o Eufrates.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֛ח יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־ הָֽאָדָ֑ם וַיַּנִּחֵ֣הוּ בְגַן־ עֵ֔דֶן לְעָבְדָ֖הּ וּלְשָׁמְרָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- hā·’ā·ḏām way·yan·ni·ḥê·hū ḇə·ḡan- ‘ê·ḏen lə·‘ā·ḇə·ḏāh ū·lə·šā·mə·rāh
verses.literal: Then the LORD God took the man and placed him in the Garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it
verses.literalPt: Tomou, pois, Deus Jeová ao homem e pô-lo no jardim do Éden para o cultivar e guardar.

verses.original: וַיְצַו֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים עַל־ הָֽאָדָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר מִכֹּ֥ל עֵֽץ־ הַגָּ֖ן אָכֹ֥ל תֹּאכֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘al- hā·’ā·ḏām lê·mōr mik·kōl ‘êṣ- hag·gān ’ā·ḵōl tō·ḵêl
verses.literal: And the LORD God . . . commanded him You may eat freely . . . from every tree of the garden
verses.literalPt: Ordenou Deus Jeová ao homem: De toda a árvore do jardim podes comer livremente;

verses.original: וּמֵעֵ֗ץ הַדַּ֙עַת֙ ט֣וֹב וָרָ֔ע לֹ֥א תֹאכַ֖ל מִמֶּ֑נּוּ כִּ֗י בְּי֛וֹם אֲכָלְךָ֥ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ מ֥וֹת תָּמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·‘êṣ had·da·‘aṯ ṭō·wḇ wā·rā‘ lō ṯō·ḵal mim·men·nū kî bə·yō·wm ’ă·ḵā·lə·ḵā mim·men·nū mō·wṯ tā·mūṯ
verses.literal: but you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil for in the day that you eat of it you will surely die . . .
verses.literalPt: mas da árvore do conhecimento do bem e do mal, dela não comerás, porque, no dia em que dela comeres, certamente morrerás.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים לֹא־ ט֛וֹב הֱי֥וֹת הָֽאָדָ֖ם לְבַדּ֑וֹ אֶֽעֱשֶׂהּ־ לּ֥וֹ עֵ֖זֶר כְּנֶגְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm lō- ṭō·wḇ hĕ·yō·wṯ hā·’ā·ḏām lə·ḇad·dōw ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- lō ‘ê·zer kə·neḡ·dōw
verses.literal: The LORD God also said It is not good for the man to be alone I will make for him a suitable helper
verses.literalPt: Disse mais Deus Jeová: Não é bom que o homem esteja só; far-lhe-ei uma ajudadora que lhe seja idônea.

verses.original: וַיִּצֶר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים מִן־ הָֽאֲדָמָ֗ה כָּל־ חַיַּ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיָּבֵא֙ אֶל־ הָ֣אָדָ֔ם לִרְא֖וֹת מַה־ יִּקְרָא־ ל֑וֹ וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִקְרָא־ ל֧וֹ הָֽאָדָ֛ם נֶ֥פֶשׁ חַיָּ֖ה ה֥וּא שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ṣer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm min- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh kāl- ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh wə·’êṯ kāl- ‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim way·yā·ḇê ’el- hā·’ā·ḏām lir·’ō·wṯ mah- yiq·rā- lōw wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer yiq·rā- lōw hā·’ā·ḏām ne·p̄eš ḥay·yāh hū šə·mōw
verses.literal: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field and every bird of the air and He brought them to the man to see what he would name . . . each one And whatever the man called . . . each living creature that was its name
verses.literalPt: Da terra formou Deus Jeová todos os animais do campo e todas as aves do céu e os trouxe ao homem para ver que nome lhes daria; o nome que o homem deu a todo o ser vivente, esse foi o seu nome.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א הָֽאָדָ֜ם שֵׁמ֗וֹת לְכָל־ הַבְּהֵמָה֙ וּלְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וּלְכֹ֖ל חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וּלְאָדָ֕ם לֹֽא־ מָצָ֥א עֵ֖זֶר כְּנֶגְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā hā·’ā·ḏām šê·mō·wṯ lə·ḵāl hab·bə·hê·māh ū·lə·‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim ū·lə·ḵōl ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh ū·lə·’ā·ḏām lō- mā·ṣā ‘ê·zer kə·neḡ·dōw
verses.literal: The man gave names to all the livestock to the birds of the air and to every beast of the field But for Adam no suitable helper was found
verses.literalPt: O homem deu nomes a todos os animais domésticos, às aves do céu e a todos os animais do campo, mas para ele não se achava uma ajudadora idônea.

verses.original: וַיַּפֵּל֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֧ים׀ תַּרְדֵּמָ֛ה עַל־ הָאָדָ֖ם וַיִּישָׁ֑ן וַיִּקַּ֗ח אַחַת֙ מִצַּלְעֹתָ֔יו וַיִּסְגֹּ֥ר בָּשָׂ֖ר תַּחְתֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yap·pêl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm tar·dê·māh ‘al- hā·’ā·ḏām way·yî·šān way·yiq·qaḥ ’a·ḥaṯ miṣ·ṣal·‘ō·ṯāw way·yis·gōr bā·śār taḥ·ten·nāh
verses.literal: So the LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep and while he slept He took one of the man’s ribs and closed up the area with flesh
verses.literalPt: Fez Deus Jeová cair um sono pesado sobre o homem, e este adormeceu; então, tomou uma das costelas do homem e fechou a carne no lugar dela.

verses.original: וַיִּבֶן֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֧ים׀ אֶֽת־ הַצֵּלָ֛ע אֲשֶׁר־ לָקַ֥ח מִן־ הָֽאָדָ֖ם לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַיְבִאֶ֖הָ אֶל־ הָֽאָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- haṣ·ṣê·lā‘ ’ă·šer- lā·qaḥ min- hā·’ā·ḏām lə·’iš·šāh way·ḇi·’e·hā ’el- hā·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: And from the rib that the LORD God had taken from the man He made a woman and brought her to him
verses.literalPt: Da costela que Deus Jeová tinha tomado do homem, formou a mulher e a trouxe ao homem.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֮ הָֽאָדָם֒ זֹ֣את הַפַּ֗עַם עֶ֚צֶם מֵֽעֲצָמַ֔י וּבָשָׂ֖ר מִבְּשָׂרִ֑י לְזֹאת֙ יִקָּרֵ֣א אִשָּׁ֔ה כִּ֥י מֵאִ֖ישׁ לֻֽקֳחָה־ זֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hā·’ā·ḏām zōṯ hap·pa·‘am ‘e·ṣem mê·‘ă·ṣā·may ū·ḇā·śār mib·bə·śā·rî lə·zōṯ yiq·qā·rê ’iš·šāh kî mê·’îš lu·qo·ḥāh- zōṯ
verses.literal: And the man said This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh she shall be called woman for out of man she was taken
verses.literalPt: Então, disse o homem: Esta, agora, é osso dos meus ossos e carne da minha carne; ela será chamada varoa, porque do varão foi tomada.

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּן֙ יַֽעֲזָב־ אִ֔ישׁ אֶת־ אָבִ֖יו וְאֶת־ אִמּ֑וֹ וְדָבַ֣ק בְּאִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וְהָי֖וּ לְבָשָׂ֥ר אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên ya·‘ă·zāḇ- ’îš ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇîw wə·’eṯ- ’im·mōw wə·ḏā·ḇaq bə·’iš·tōw wə·hā·yū lə·ḇā·śār ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife and they will become one flesh
verses.literalPt: Portanto, deixa o homem a seu pai e a sua mãe e se une à sua mulher; e são uma só carne.

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְי֤וּ שְׁנֵיהֶם֙ עֲרוּמִּ֔ים הָֽאָדָ֖ם וְאִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֖א יִתְבֹּשָֽׁשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū šə·nê·hem ‘ă·rūm·mîm hā·’ā·ḏām wə·’iš·tōw wə·lō yiṯ·bō·šā·šū
verses.literal: And the man and his wife were both naked and they were not ashamed
verses.literalPt: Estavam ambos nus, o homem e sua mulher, e não se envergonhavam.
